state.ui: Lua error window over the first cinematic frames

options: SKIP_CINEMATIC: dismiss the intro and reach the character
WATCH_INTRO: let the flyover and subtitles play
ALT_F4: quit from the error window
evidence: The Skyborne flyover and subtitles continue from 00m11s through 01m05s.

state.enemies: none, only players and friendly NPCs

options: STAND_AND_LOOK: hold position in the crowd
evidence: 01m08s–01m11s the character stays put, camera behind them, no target frame.
01m15s–01m22s they remain in the same spot while chat bubbles play.

options: CLOSE_LOG_AND_STAY: shut the log and keep looking
TRACK_ON_MINIMAP: run at the yellow marker
evidence: 01m33s the log is gone and they are still standing in the crowd through 01m40s.

state.visible: glowing blue wisp on the path, beast field ahead

options: PASS_THE_WISP: keep walking to the field
evidence: 02m27s–02m29s they are past the glow and looking over the beast field.

options: OPEN_KEYBINDS: open Controls from the escape menu
evidence: Escape menu at 02m56s, Controls window open 02m57s–03m01s, no new target.
The world map is open on the left at 03m09s and closed by 03m10s.

options: KEEP_BOLTING: finish with the cast bar only
evidence: Spellbook covers the left side 03m27s–03m34s while damage numbers continue, Restoration tab shows Healing Wave.
Quest log is open 04m14s–04m23s while the character stands still.
Guild window opens at 04m52s and is still up at 04m53s.

state.target: a beast visible to the right of the window

options: PULL_WITH_WINDOW_OPEN: bolt without closing the guild UI
CLOSE_UI_FIRST: clear the screen then pull
DECLINE_ALL_GUILDS: use the window and stop
evidence: 04m54s–04m58s lightning and a kill happen while the guild window stays open.

options: CHAIN_ANOTHER: bolt the next beast immediately
CLOSE_GUILD_AND_LOOT: stop to manage the window
evidence: 05m00s–05m04s a new bolt, damage, and a corpse, guild window never closed.

options: READ_RECRUITMENT: open the guild info page
JOIN_AND_HEARTH: accept and leave the zone
evidence: 05m11s–05m14s a second guild text panel is open and they are not casting.

options: READ_BAR_TOOLTIP: hover a spell while walking
evidence: A spell tooltip stays on the right 05m32s–05m41s and no target frame appears.

options: CHECK_LAKE_THEN_PATH: yaw to the water and back
evidence: 06m02s–06m03s look at the lake, 06m05s they are facing the path again.

options: LOOT_TOOLTIP: pop loot and clear the target
BODY_PULL_NEXT: step into the upper pack
evidence: 06m19s shows a loot tooltip and 06m20s the target frame is gone.

options: HOVER_SPELLS: read bar tooltips before the next pull
evidence: Spell tooltips are up at 06m21s–06m23s while they stand and turn.

options: OPEN_VIDEO_OPTIONS: change graphics from the escape menu
evidence: Escape menu at 06m26s and the video options window at 06m28s–06m31s.

state.ui: loading screen with the isle artwork

evidence: 06m32s–06m35s is a full loading screen, and 06m36s is the same hillside again.

options: ENTER_QUICK_KEYBIND: open the binding list and the bind dialog
evidence: 06m55s–06m57s the keybinding list is open, and 06m58s–07m05s the quick-keybind dialog is up.

state.enemies: a crawler has walked up beside the character

options: STAY_IN_DIALOG: finish the bind before fighting
ESC_AND_BOLT: close and attack the crawler now
RUN_THROUGH_THE_MOB: path away with the dialog up
evidence: 07m03s–07m05s the crawler stands next to them and the dialog is still the front window.
08m03s–08m05s the target is clear and they remain standing on the path.

state.ui: red script-error banner at the top

options: OPEN_CHARACTER_SHEET: read stats instead of drinking
DRINK: fix the short mana bar
DISMISS_ERROR_AND_PULL: clear the banner and chain
evidence: 08m20s–08m28s the character panel is open, they are standing, the error banner remains.

options: STEP_ALONG_THE_WALL: move to the next cliff crawler
RETURN_TO_THE_FIELD: go back to the corpses
evidence: 08m44s–08m45s they walk the base of the cliff, target clear.

state.visible: a blue crystal and many corpses

options: PULL_A_FAR_PACK: run to the upper clump
evidence: 09m18s–09m21s they walk past the crystal and the corpses with no interaction.

state.ui: error banner returns during the cast

options: BOLT_ANYWAY: pull through the error banner
PICK_A_PACK: tag the group behind it
evidence: 09m22s–09m25s one crawler takes a 5 then a 15 while the red banner is on screen.
